reviews.text: Since this shop opened, the sidewalks have become very smelly when I get off the bus... I hope you can do something about it.
I participated in a puppy class. I received excellent advice regarding my puppy's excitability and biting habits. I would definitely like to continue attending classes in the future!

I learned the very basics of obedience training. I think repetition will be necessary.

I felt that the class might be unsatisfying for dogs that can already sit, stay, and come. Puppy kindergarten would probably be fun.

I felt that corrective training for grown dogs, especially large breeds, would be difficult. The room is small, but they might take the dogs outside for training, so that needs to be confirmed.

I participated in a free trial session.

At first, my dog ​​was quite excited due to being in an unfamiliar place, but I was taught how to calm him down. It felt like he could change once he learned how to interact with people.
It was fun and easy to understand!
I had the opportunity to participate in the opening ceremony.
I think I now understand a little bit of what you were worried about regarding jumping into things too quickly.
I'm so happy that Tokyo Dog opened nearby!

Thank you.
